newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Tuesday, September 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Tuesday, September 17.

text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.
*Tangentopoli (Bribesville) returns with the arrest of Lorenzo Necci, managing director of Italy's state railway, in corruption probe. (all)

*Interior Minister Giorgio Napolitano says the government will not tolerate the setting up of a militia force by secessionist Northern league party. Nothern League leader Umberto Bossi replies that if he is arrested he will declare himself prisoner of war (all).

*Chief executive of Olivetti Francesco Caio has been put under preliminary investigation by magistrates into the group's accounts. The move hit Olivetti shares which fell to a record low before being suspended. Meanwhile, stock market watchdog Consob demands Olivetti answer 16 questions over its financial statements by today (all).
* The government must find 3-4 trillion lire for the 97 budget. Labour Minister Tiziano Treu says that pension funds could contribute around 3 trillion (Corriere).
* Finance Minister Vincenzo Visco announces a new system to cross-check revenues in order to fight tax evasion (all).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
